Honestly, is the pricier one worth the extra, or is the cheaper one fine?Tushbaby Shopping AssistantBoth options offer great value, but cater to different needs:

Tushbaby Hip Carrier: Praised by reviewers like Michelle C. for its sturdy design and comfort, it's ideal for everyday use and supports children up to 45 lbs.
2-in-1 Convertible Carrier: Offers hands-free convenience and versatility, perfect for growing needs and activities like grocery runs.
The Tushbaby Hip Carrier $75.004.8 (8k)2-in-1 Convertible Carrier$142.00$168.004.8 (1.1k)Michelle C.5.0My son has become a little Velcro baby but he’s growing so fast and getting heavy! My shoulders, arms and lower back have been hurting from carrying him. I saw there were other forms of this hip carrier out there and they seemed flimsy. This carrier is worth every penny. The piece that goes around your waist is thick and supportive and there’s the safety buckle as well. This carrier doesn’t budge on my waist even with my son on my hip. The piece he sits on is so heavy duty and sturdy, I know he is safe sitting on it. I bought the hands free one because we have a few hands free carriers we received from our shower but I love how this one allows him to sit forward or inward easily if he’s fussy. He’s fallen asleep in my arms on this. 10000% recommend this hip carrier, it takes your child’s weight off your arms, shoulders and back and I couldn't recommend it enough if your little one is in that stage of being carried but you want something you can slip on, rock/walk them to sleep and then easily transfer them for naps.Read More#widget-icon--r9- path, #widget-icon--r9- rect { fill: currentColor !important; }Which features are most important to you in a carrier?Hands-free convenience is keyI need something for daily errandsLooking for extra storage spaceEase of use is my priorityCan it handle a toddler?#widget-icon--r7- path, #widget-icon--r7- rect { fill: var(--envive-colors-border-light) !important; }
